findings.finding: To prove K complete the source says K reduces to K_0, and the exercise asks for that already established direction; completeness instead requires K_0 to reduce to K.
findings.controlling_evidence: K_0 was just proved complete, so transitivity transfers completeness to K only from K_0 <=_m K. The s-m-n construction used for K_1 also supplies this direction.
findings.required_translation_handling: Reverse both statements to K_0 <=_m K and add an adjacent OLTECOMTHY-015 disclosure.
